headline: Cabinet plans to contain inflation at 7% in 2026–2027 » Gazeta.kg - Kyrgyzstan and Bishkek news today
summary: The Kyrgyz cabinet discussed a draft action plan to stabilise prices of goods and services for 2026–2027. The plan targets inflation at 7%.
why: Inflation targets guide household purchasing power and the policy choices that shape the Kyrgyz som and local borrowing costs.
